mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing activity and corporate capacity utilization, supporting earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer spending and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise month-over-month, or the interaction term in a regression has p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 10% year-over-year signals strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST YoY growth > 10%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production regime (INDPRO > 108.0), a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals tight labor markets that support manufacturing output and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high industrial output with tight labor
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 108.0 and UNRATE < 4.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 2.5% signals persistent inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal monetary tightening that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise, or the interaction term in a regression has p-value > 0.05.
